Studio Engine

procedural audiovisual engine

Studio Engine is a local Python simulation and rendering engine that generates shader visuals, audio, and motion from one reusable scene description. It exposes a CLI and local HTTP API, can render deterministic PNG frames, and records hashes and a receipt for each generated scene.

Architecture, dependencies, and relationship notes

Dependencies

None declared in the public registry.

Relation-backed claims

  • Studio Engine optional native render bridge RAW
    Studio Engine can locate and invoke the optional RAW native CLI bridge; its Python core remains usable without RAW.

Current evidence

Studio Engine public source

Verified 2026-08-27

How we know

The public main branch identifies Studio Engine 0.2.0; no GitHub release is claimed.

Studio Engine optional RAW CLI bridge

Verified 2026-08-28

How we know

The pinned Python module defines RAW's native CLI as a separately built optional renderer and records honest absence when it is unavailable.

Limitations and authorization boundaries

  • Studio Engine is not presented as a finished product.
  • Browsers, GPUs, and audio hosts realize its programs; the native renderer is optional and APIs may move before 1.0.

Authorization boundary. Generated media must respect the rights, licenses, and consent attached to its inputs and intended use.
